prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce exactly ONE clear high-fidelity Simplified Chinese desktop DooKnow settings-page design for an authenticated owner, straight-on full application canvas around 1536×1024, no browser/device frame, no external title/caption.
INPUT AUTHORITY: Image 1 is this exact running pre-redesign settings baseline, authoritative for existing content, controls, navigation, permissions and selected state. Image 2 PILOT-WS-001 is ONLY the approved DooKnow palette, typography/density and rail/header hierarchy reference. Do not import its notebook tree, empty-note content or note toolbar. Real source templates override generic API summaries.
Shared shell: full-height approximately 64px muted gray owner rail at far left, account avatar O at top; real destinations 笔记, 最近, 收藏, separator, 应用; bottom 回收站 and 设置, with 设置 active. Full 56px global header to the right of owner rail: existing blue open-book logo and exact DooKnow wordmark, divider, static context 设置. No invented header actions, counts or notifications. Below header use a light-gray contextual settings sidebar with 返回笔记 and exactly eight destinations in order: 通用与编辑, 知识库与存储, 搜索与索引, 备份与恢复, 后台状态, 插件与连接, 账号与安全, 关于与诊断; select only current destination. Main content is white, flexible max approximately 1000px, aligned card edges/fields and readable compact desktop text. Preserve existing page eyebrow 设置, page title, description and top-right 返回笔记.
Style: flat white #ffffff surfaces and #f7f8fa rail/sidebar, text #272b3a secondary #657084, thin #e6e9f1 separators, blue #4566c6 primary actions and #edf1ff selected rows, restrained 8px radii, no gradients/textures/heavy shadows. Preserve exact controls and their enabled/disabled state. Legible Chinese and clear spacing matter more than decorative polish.
Hard invariants: one coherent actual baseline state; do not combine mutually exclusive overlays or states. No ToDoo brand, tasks, calendars, habits, teams, members, AI chat, new features or invented navigation. No protocol metadata fields (requestId, versions, hash, cursor, nonce, CSRF), no developer/contract captions inside UI, no new fake connected/online/success states. Secrets masked, server paths /srv/example only if actually expanded. Static concept does not prove runtime/interaction/responsiveness.
PAGE-SPECIFIC CONTENT:
CURRENT PAGE 搜索与索引. Description 查看当前可用的搜索能力及索引状态。 Exactly preserve baseline NOT READY runtime state, no editable inputs. First card 本地检索 with magnifier icon, description 查看关键词与语义搜索的可用情况。准备期间仍可浏览和编辑笔记。 Two side-by-side status subpanels: 文本检索 with gray dot 依赖未准备，索引任务已暂停; 语义检索 with gray dot 暂不可用. Keep collapsed disclosure 高级运行信息. Keep factual note 当前暂时没有可下载的搜索组件。你可以继续使用知识库。 and single outlined refresh action 检查检索状态. Do not invent download/install/rebuild controls in this unavailable source state, do not show success/online/running badges. Below separate 索引与搜索 card with full exact explanatory paragraph 文件名搜索可以直接使用；关键词与语义搜索的实际可用情况以上方检查结果为准。新笔记保存后会进入索引队列，进度可从设置中的「后台状态」查看。 Rest of main area white, full-height owner rail/header visible.

A | ST-003 | 搜索与索引 | role=authenticated-owner | state=实际baseline原状态/隔离示例的完整主布局；其他互斥状态另列设计板

完整搜索与索引页：本地检索准备/检查、文本和语义独立状态、索引说明；外部管理或无发行源时不出现可准备假操作。

精确字段/操作/权限合同（API元数据不画成输入）：
ST-003权限：管理API要求已登录所有者；除独立/auth处理路径外，/api写请求须同源Origin及x-csrf-token；维护模式503（apps/server/app.ts:141）。
ST-003真实可见字段顺序：无额外编辑输入，不发明控件。
ST-003动作白名单：准备本地检索 => 下载并安装可用搜索组件；guard=已登录所有者；请求期间禁用重复操作；接口约束=POST /api/platform/search-runtime/prepare

硬性禁止：

所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。

内容参考：匹配真实baseline时沿用knowledge/Asia/Shanghai，公开夹具“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客已保存accent #44684f与journal/magazine/profile差异保留。未捕获状态只用明确合成示例，数量/成功/客户端状态不成为固定业务结果。登录空占位、秘密掩码，禁止照搬ToDoo任务内容。

状态编号/说明放产品画面外。仅fields是真实可见输入；requestId/version/hash/cursor/nonce/CSRF等只作后台guard。输出不是实测通过或审批；逐图功能/权限/响应式审查与全局审查完成前不得开发。
